messages:
Alex G: Quick async SRE check-in — SLOs, alerting, oncall follow-ups. What I did / blockers / today

Maria T: Did: tweaked error-rate alert thresholds for inference-prod (reduced p99 window). Saw immediate drop in noisy flights for model B.
Maria T: Blocker: KV-cache eviction spikes still causing p50/p99 token latency blips when cold misses hit. Repro on staging during high-concurrency.

Samir P: Did: rolled new restart/backoff policy for worker-pool b, deployed at 02:30 UTC. Added extra log context for evict decisions.
Samir P: Today: running canary of evict-heuristic (config evict_strategy=v2) against a single AZ; will follow up with metrics.

Casey: FYI I merged the runbook PR with clearer escalation steps (see snippet below). Pls review asap if you rely on these steps.
```
- step 1: check redis: `redis-cli info keyspace`
- step 2: run `evict-diagnose.sh --target endpoint`
- step 3: if miss_rate > 5% and p99_latency > 1s -> escalate to runtime oncall
```

Alex G: Ping @Samir P for CR review on evict-heuristic (PR #342). Also can we add a short dashboard tile for `kv_cache_miss_rate` and `token_latency_p99` on the main SLO board?

Samir P: On it — will add Grafana panel and link it in the PR description.

Maria T: oncall-bot: please create an incident if `p99_latency > 1200` for 10m on any prod inference route.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1127 assigned to Maria T (auto-detected rule).

Alex G: Blocker for me: waiting on Dedicated capacity quota approval so infra can run the patch rolling deploy without throttling. @finance / @ops-team can you confirm ETA?

Casey: Quick ask: any objections to enabling short-lived warming jobs for large-model endpoints to reduce cold-start p50? :thinking_face: Schedule during low traffic window (02:00–04:00 UTC).
Maria T: +1 from me, schedule is fine. Need to add a throttling guard to avoid bursting network io.

Alex G: Action items:
- Samir: add grafana panels + link to PR (#342) — ETA EOD
- Maria: continue canary and share failure replay if eviction spikes reproduce — ETA tomorrow morning
- Casey: update runbook with warming job knobs and throttling note — will do today
- Alex: follow up with finance/ops on quota, and post update to #eng-runtime if infra changes required

Alex G: Thanks everyone — end of check-in.
